# zig-notify

> Cross-platform desktop notification library in Zig with C FFI -- macOS (osascript) and Linux (libnotify).

Part of the [Tinyland Zig Libraries](https://libs.tinyland.dev).

## Installation

```
zig fetch --save git+https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-notify.git
```

## Full Documentation

- [API reference](https://libs.tinyland.dev/api/zig-notify/): Zig autodoc
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jesssullivan/zig-notify/main/llms-full.txt): Complete API dump for LLMs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-notify/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Agent instructions

## C API (4 functions)

- `zig_notify_init(app_name, app_name_len)`: Initialize backend (Linux: notify_init, macOS: no-op). Returns 0/-1.
- `zig_notify_send(title, title_len, body, body_len, urgency)`: Send notification. body may be NULL. Returns 0/-1.
- `zig_notify_request_permission()`: Request permission (currently no-op). Returns 0/-1/-2.
- `zig_notify_deinit()`: Clean up resources (Linux: notify_uninit, macOS: no-op).

## Build

```
zig build                    # build static library
zig build test               # run unit tests
zig build docs               # generate API docs
```

## Platform Support

- macOS 13+ (arm64/x86_64): osascript, no dependencies
- Linux (x86_64/arm64): libnotify-dev + glib-2.0
